files.README.md:
# Bramble & Crate - orders export

One row per order. customer_id identifies the account and one account
can place several orders in the month. The export job retried on a few
nights, so some orders appear twice.
files.notes/market_stalls.txt:
Saturday stalls rotate between the green rows and the riverside rows. Since
the loading dock repair, wholesale dispatches leave from the barn yard.

turns.prompt: Bramble & Crate is sizing its wholesale account base before the holiday season. The orders export is at orders/sept_orders.csv. Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. How many different customers placed Wholesale orders in September 2026?
